output.objection: You are framing my concession on the shadow hand off as if I am giving up the sign off step, but I am only asking for the dependency to be acknowledged before we talk about governance. I will not accept a silent removal of the review gate just because you fixed the data flow.
output.correction: I did not propose deleting the sign off step, I proposed that we do not pretend it is safe until the shadow hand off is stable. You are misreading my priority on the dependency as a waiver of the control itself.
